name: Small Circular Offering Dish with Three Clawed-Cabriole Legs and with Stylized Lotus and Goose-in-Flight Decor
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；first half 8th century；Sancai ("three-color") ware: white earthenware with lead-fluxed emerald-green and caramel-brown glazes over stamped decoration. Probably from kilns at Luoyang or Gongxian, Henan province.
